findings.text: Une saison ne se joue pas seulement sur le terra
findings.msg: starts "color" (0.2 s) the moment it is scrolled into view (an IntersectionObserver) on span.mo-w:nth-of-type(1) (inside a dealt moment's section, [data-moment]: an enter moment is expected on every kind; its still is judged under reduced motion)
findings.fix: show it at rest: no fade, rise or unmask when it is scrolled into view

findings.msg: "Sous le capot." names no product, part, place or section (the one brand line a page may have)
findings.fix: name the thing in every heading: the product, a part, the place or a section noun

findings.msg: "Voir les robots" does not start with a verb (book, buy, try, start, get, see...) (and 1 more like it: "Envoyer le message")
findings.fix: label buttons with a verb and what the visitor gets ("Book a room", "Start free trial")

findings.msg: an empty hole 888x300px inside the section (33% of the screen's height), with content above and below it
findings.fix: close the empty space: move the content together, or give the space the visual it lacks

findings.msg: "Robot Phoenix Team" opens a section headed "RoboCupJunior Soccer en Île-de-France"
findings.fix: name each nav link after the heading of the section it opens

findings.msg: the nav stays on screen with 4 links to the page's sections, but never marks the one you are in (no link changes as the page scrolls)
findings.fix: mark the link of the section on screen (a colour, a weight or a line under it) as the visitor scrolls

findings.msg: the button "Voir les robots" (#e0dcd3) stands only 1.19:1 off the ground around it: it reads as part of the ground, or as switched off
findings.fix: give the button a fill that stands at least 1.5:1 off what is around it, or an outline in the ink

findings.msg: 42% of the section is empty: 256px of empty rows between its content, 6% beside content that covers under half the container, in its 720px of rows (WARN over 35%, FAIL over 50%)
findings.fix: fill the section: a picture or a second column beside the words, or more of its own content; the section stays one or two screens tall (T-height)

findings.msg: "L'équipe" is an h4 after an h2: a level is skipped (in the header or footer)
findings.fix: step down one level at a time (h1, h2, h3): change the tag, not the look; a footer's column heads are h3

findings.msg: "contacter l'équipe" shows 2 times on the first screen at 1440px (nav, hero): the nav's button and the hero's; nothing else on the screen may repeat it
findings.fix: show the action once a screen besides the nav's button: the hero's, the close's or the phone bar's, never all at once

findings.msg: the form opens a mail to contact@robot-phoenix.example: a stand-in until the client gives its form address; list it in the report
findings.fix: send the form to the client's address (data-endpoint) and show the confirmation only after it answers; list a mailto stand-in in the report
